messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth
function.description: Establishes a connection to a Bluetooth device using its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

device_name.description: The name of the Bluetooth device to connect to.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to attempt a connection before timing out.

auto_reconnect.description: Whether to automatically attempt to reconnect if the connection is lost.

message.content:
Below is a concise list of the **long‑weekend** dates that occurred in Canada during 2023.  
A long‑weekend is defined as a statutory holiday that falls on a Friday or a Monday (or is observed on a Monday when it falls on a weekend), creating a three‑day break that includes the weekend.

| Holiday | Date in 2023 | Observed (if different) | Long‑Weekend Dates |
|---------|--------------|--------------------------|--------------------|
| New Year’s Day | Sunday Jan 1 | Observed Monday Jan 2 | Jan 1–3 |
| Family Day (BC, AB, SK, NB) | Monday Feb 20 | – | Feb 18–20 |
| St. Patricks Day (Ontario) | Monday Mar 20 | – | Mar 18–20 |
| Good Friday | Friday Apr 7 | – | Apr 7–9 |
| Victoria Day | Monday May 22 | – | May 20–22 |
| Canada Day | Tuesday Jul 1 | Observed Monday Jul 3 | Jul 1–3 |
| Labour Day | Monday Sep 4 | – | Sep 2–4 |
| Thanksgiving (Canada) | Monday Oct 9 | – | Oct 7–9 |
| Remembrance Day | Saturday Nov 11 | Observed Monday Nov 13 | Nov 11–13 |
| Christmas Day | Monday Dec 25 | – | Dec 23–25 |
| Boxing Day | Tuesday Dec 26 | Observed Monday Dec 27 | Dec 26–28 |

**Notes**

* Some holidays (e.g., Family Day, St. Patricks Day) are province‑specific; the table lists the provinces where they are statutory holidays.  
* Canada Day was observed on Monday Jul 3 because the actual holiday fell on a Tuesday.  
* Remembrance Day is a statutory holiday in most provinces, but the observed date (Monday Nov 13) is used for the long‑weekend calculation.  

Feel free to integrate this table into your holiday‑planning app. If you need province‑specific details or additional holidays, let me know!
